title: GM Control, Simulation Depth & Advisory AI
objective: Deliver one bounded read-only GM-control projection for ODL advisory depth and optional advisory-AI presentation over completed ODL-01..07 evidence, without changing canonical truth, running a second simulation engine, issuing commands, granting permissions, revealing hidden data, invoking paid/provider AI, persisting ODL state or implementing SCL mechanics.

resolved_contract.control_authority_rule: ODL-08 accepts GM-control settings only inside an already-authorized game-master or explicitly delegated assistant-gm context identified by an opaque authority reference. ODL-08 does not create roles, delegations, permissions or decision authority; MV-IA-F006 and MV-IA-F020 remain authoritative for those boundaries.
resolved_contract.depth_rule: Simulation depth is presentation/advisory granularity only. Overview exposes compact visible source/state summaries, standard adds visible source references and explanations, and deep adds the full already-visible owner/provenance/reference detail supplied to ODL-08. Changing depth never changes an ODL-01..07 projection state, canonical owner truth, mechanical rule, Event, Project/time state or SCL outcome.
resolved_contract.source_selection_rule: An authorized GM may enable or disable which ODL-01..07 advisory sources appear in the ODL-08 surface. Source selection changes only the ODL-08 presentation set; it never deletes, mutates, recomputes or suppresses canonical owning-domain state outside this projection.
resolved_contract.ai_rule: Optional AI is advisory presentation only. ODL-08 consumes explicit already-produced advisory records over the initiating user's authorized visible projection and never invokes a provider. AI may summarize, call attention, pose a question or offer a candidate option; it has no user role, actor control, decision, modification, approval, denial, commit, command, permission, mechanical resolution, route legality, hidden-truth or completion authority.
resolved_contract.ai_basis_rule: Every visible AI advisory names its visible ODL basis observation references. Summary/attention/question output may describe visible unresolved evidence without resolving it. A candidate-option is surfaced only when all visible basis observations are resolved; unknown, conflict or incompatible basis yields an uncertainty notice instead of a candidate option. AI text never becomes canonical evidence merely by being displayed.
resolved_contract.owner_commit_rule: ODL-08 exposes no owner-mutation or executable command surface. Any future canonical change suggested by a human or AI remains a separate proposal/decision for the owning domain and requires that domain's current authorization, validation and durable commit path. Silence, AI confidence, GM title, organization role or ODL state is never approval.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized ODL source evidence, owner references, Project/time context, profile/context, provenance, permission evidence and AI advisories are filtered before depth selection, source lists, unresolved flags, counts, summaries, search, provenance, receipts or AI-facing output. Hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
resolved_contract.project_time_rule: APW-D26 Project/time/context authority remains unchanged. ODL-08 may carry already-visible Project/time references as context only; wall-clock time, projected elapsed time and depth/AI settings never advance campaign time or mutate Projects.
resolved_contract.scl_rule: SCL remains future authority for scale taxonomy, units/formations, readiness, command hierarchy, orders, phases, aggregate resolution, casualties/damage and strategic consequences. ODL-08 may surface advisory organization context for future command decisions but cannot issue orders or adjudicate outcomes.
resolved_contract.determinism_rule: For the same authorized visible inputs and GM-control settings, ODL-08 ordering, unresolved handling, detail selection and deterministic receipt are stable; AI prose itself is treated as opaque advisory input and is not part of canonical truth.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable ODL-08 state, duplicate GM-control/AI/organization/SCL ledger or migration 0022. Provider activation remains closed.
resolved_contract.validation: Acceptance first; genuine self-hosted RED while production contract/panel are absent; exactly one ODL-08 current-family Validation Core profile with zero historical predecessor fanout; final exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows plus deterministic comparison.

preserved_boundaries: ODL-01..07 remain completed_verified and are not reopened.
Canonical organization/faction/relationship, Character, business/economy, base/vehicle, settlement/World, Project/time/context, DPL/WCI and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative.
MV-IA-F006 human GM/Assistant-GM decision authority and MV-IA-F020 deny-by-default authorization remain unchanged; AI has no role or mutation authority.
APM-04 remains separate automated-play authority and confirms AI presentation is nonauthoritative; ODL-08 does not create an AutoGM or second simulation engine.
No owner mutation, autonomous command/action/system permission, hidden-data reveal, duplicate ledger, durable persistence, provider invocation or migration 0022 is authorized.
ODL-09, SCL-01+ implementation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
